card.title: THE BOY WHO READ THE WIND

captions.text: The sky tears open over the final battlefield.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Red light, black light, and a whole world holding its breath.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta! Wake up! Asta!
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Asta falls, and the world goes silent. Then church bells. Cold sheets.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Small, trembling hands. Same bed, same church, same cracked ceiling.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta was never supposed to have magic.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: What if he remembered everything? The Spade raid.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The betrayals. Every name, every face, every grave.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And the brother sealed inside the wall of Hage's tower.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: All of it, in the head of a six year old boy.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The wind in Hage comes down off the demon skull, and nobody ever thinks twice about it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta thinks about nothing else. He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ki. The breath and the heartbeat of the world.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The air shifts.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Three seconds later, Yuno's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hey. You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved. How?
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Heh. Lucky guess.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Yuno is six, and still a crybaby. Last time, Asta mocked him for it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: This time, he hands him a handkerchief.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I wasn't crying! It was the wind, okay?
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Sure it was. Totally the wind.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Why are you being nice to me? It's weird. What do you want?
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Call it an investment.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: It confuses everyone. The loudest kid in Hage has gone quiet, and he watches everything.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sister Lily, marry me!
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.
captions.speaker: SISTER_LILY

captions.text: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And for the first time in history, Asta steps aside.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It missed! Lily's fist missed! That's never happened!
captions.speaker: FATHER_ORSI

captions.text: Oh my. Asta, you're growing up so fast.
captions.speaker: SISTER_LILY

captions.text: At seven, Asta asks Yuno for a blindfold, then tells him to throw everything he has.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat. He slips between them like smoke.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: How did you know?
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Throw harder. You breathe in right before you cast.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Yuno goes very still. He isn't used to being the one who's behind.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And he hates how it feels.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then I'll learn not to. I'll be Wizard King first, you'll see.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Try it. I'm still beating you there, Yuno.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grimoire tower.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And he knows exactly how long it has been waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Age ten. Midnight. The grimoire tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Five leaves. He's waited four years to touch it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: His fingers close on the cover, and the tower vanishes. Black water.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: No floor, no sky. Something vast turns over in the dark, and it's hungry.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and every single one of them is aimed at him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A magicless brat, walking right into my mouth. How convenient.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I'll be wearing you by morning.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Asta doesn't raise a hand.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He just looks up, the way you look at someone you've missed for years.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Why aren't you scared, boy?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your name is Liebe.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Who told you that? Nobody knows that name.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your mother named you. Her name was Licita.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Don't. Don't say that name.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Licita. She held you until the very end.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: I said don't!
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: That she chose you. Every single time.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Nothing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She was my mother too.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: No. That's not possible.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: She left me at a church door so I'd live.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Who are you?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your brother. And I'm late.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Last time, I was fifteen years late.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Last time? What does that mean?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Later. First, let me sit down.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: What do you want from me?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Just to sit here a minute. With my brother.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Tch. You're the dumbest human I've ever met.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Probably. I've been told.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hage. Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still. Not trapped. Waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Five years. By day, Ki footwork until his legs shake.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks. About bread. About Yuno. About the sky.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Today Yuno tried to cut a tree. The tree won.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: You're boring me to death, human. Bread? Seriously, bread?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Then why do you keep answering?
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: I'm stuck in a book. Echoes are all I get.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The book won't open before the ceremony.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: So Asta waits, again. But this time, he isn't waiting alone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Make the contract. Master and servant. That's how it works.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: No. Equals, or nothing.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Tch. Fine. Equals. Whatever. Like I care.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Yuno steps forward, and a four-leaf grimoire answers him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then it's Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Only laughter, rolling across the hall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They're laughing at you. Doesn't that bother you?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Not anymore. I know how this ends.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the road home, Revchi steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists. He wants Yuno's grimoire.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He doesn't notice the magicless boy who's already standing behind him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody ever does.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Revchi. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Magicless trash like you has no right to—
captions.speaker: REVCHI

captions.text: Skip it.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The five-leaf grimoire rips itself free and tears across the sky, straight for his hand.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hurry up, partner. I'm getting bored over here.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Revchi's chains don't break. They simply stop existing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ha! Now that's what I'm talking about.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: My chains! What did you do to my chains?
captions.speaker: REVCHI

captions.text: You've been hiding something since we were six.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Only a few things.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Fine. Keep your secrets. Just leave me an enemy next time.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Then be faster, Yuno.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Hmph. I was letting you have it.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yami Sukehiro. Alive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta's breath catches. He remembers losing that man, and now he's standing right there, yawning.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: No reason. Really.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Stop it. You're creeping me out, kid.
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: Sorry. Long story.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: His match lasts one breath.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Not bad, brat. Where'd you learn that?
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: A very patient teacher.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then another. Hands that never went up for him before.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Noelle Silva. Last time, her water magic ran wild for months, and Asta watched her become the pride of her house.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Today she's at the edge of the field, spilling water over her own boots.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Eyes off, commoner. My magic is just having a bad day.
captions.speaker: NOELLE

captions.text: It's not a bad day. You're aiming at your family's approval.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Aim at something you want to protect.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I didn't ask a commoner for advice.
captions.speaker: NOELLE

captions.text: But her fingers close anyway. She thinks of nothing she has to win, only of what she'd stand in front of.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And the water rises in her bare palm. No wand. Round, and perfectly still.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It's holding. It's actually holding. It's listening to me.
captions.speaker: NOELLE

captions.text: Yeah. That one's all yours.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls aren't exactly—
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: Black Bulls. I'm in. Sign me up.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Across the arena, Yuno signs with the Golden Dawn.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: His wind moves before he breathes in. That's what years of chasing one boy will do.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Don't fall behind, Asta.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Don't trip, Yuno.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He knows exactly where to look.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: William Vangeance sits very still, and inside him there are two Ki. Two lives. One body.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But this time, someone feels it back.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind William's calm eyes, Patolli turns, slow as a blade, toward the boy who is looking.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Above them all, Wizard King Julius Novachrono tilts his head. He's watching the boy.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Oh? This boy's time doesn't move like ours.
captions.speaker: JULIUS

captions.text: Someone has wound it back. How interesting.
captions.speaker: JULIUS

captions.text: That night, on the road to the Black Bulls' hideout, the air above the trees folds open like torn cloth.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: White-robed mages step out, one after another. The Eye of the Midnight Sun. Months early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: None of this happened in his first life. Asta stops walking.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The future he memorized has just stopped being true.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In Part Two,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: the Eye of the Midnight Sun comes for the one boy who knows exactly how this story ends.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Wind's changed. Fine. Then I'll learn to read it all over again.
captions.speaker: ASTA
